requirements: R1: Reconcile internal task status with actual GitHub PR state so that closed but unmerged PRs do not falsely leave tasks marked as done

slices.title: Patch PR state synchronization mismatch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR synchronization fix for this epic, I want to properly interpret unmerged closed PRs from GitHub, so that the internal task status is correctly reverted or prevented from reaching done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task incorrectly marked as done when its GitHub PR is closed without merge
When the synchronization logic evaluates the GitHub PR state
Then the internal status is atomically corrected using the correct GitHub state
Then automated tests verify that false positive completion is prevented
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive done tasks from unmerged PRs to 0 occurrences
